cards.prompt: Water can act as a mild irritant to skin when exposure is prolonged.
cards.answer: Fact: prolonged water exposure strips natural oils and disrupts the skin barrier.

cards.prompt: What does hot water strip from the skin that leaves it dry?
Explain like I'm 10: how does hard water dry out your skin?
cards.answer: Hard water has lots of calcium and magnesium. They react with soap and make gunk that sticks on your skin, which adds to the drying.

cards.prompt: What role does chlorine in tap water play on skin?
cards.answer: It is an oxidizing agent that can further weaken the skin barrier.

cards.prompt: Which is NOT something that makes water harsher on skin?
cards.answer: Lukewarm water is the recommended fix; the others make water more irritating.

cards.prompt: Your skin feels tight and itchy after every shower. What two changes could help?
cards.answer: Use lukewarm water close to body temperature and keep showers short, since water itself may be partly to blame.
